project_name: CloudBurst Guadalupe County data center campus
aliases: CloudBurst Texas LLC / Data Center LB
developer: CloudBurst Data Centers / CloudBurst Texas LLC / Data Center LB, L.P.
status_detail: Guadalupe County Commissioners Court approved CloudBurst's development agreement and tax abatement on April 21, 2026. County presentation describes a 706.40-acre, 10-12 building, roughly 3 million sq ft AI-ready campus with three 400 MW phases, 1.2 GW total capacity, behind-the-meter generation, and 2026-2029 phased development. DCD reported the project is split across Hays and Guadalupe counties and initial 50 MW had already broken ground for Q4 2026 go-live.
notes: County presentation is primary source for 1.2 GW/acreage/building count; DCD adds split-county and initial-phase status details. Location described as near San Marcos between Center Point Road, Francis Harris Lane, and Huber Road/York Creek area.
